title: Harden unified multimodal search

context.summary: Add a unified multimodal search surface over document chunks, derived artifact text spans and face identities/observations.
context.background: Document and artifact search currently exist as separate endpoints. TASK-81 adds a single search API plus CLI/MCP surfaces that can combine metadata filters, full-text artifact spans, OCR, transcripts, captions, face identities and configured vector-backed document chunk search.

in: Add a core unified search service that combines document chunk search, artifact span search and face identity/observation hits.
Add POST /v1/search with project-scoped authorization, metadata filters, target filters and source refs.
Allow artifact search to run metadata-only queries when metadata filters or type filters are provided.
Expose unified search through CLI and MCP.
Verify text, OCR/caption, transcript, video keyframe, face and metadata-only search paths.
Update documentation and validators for the unified search surface.
out: New vector tables for image or face vectors.
Advanced ranking fusion beyond deterministic score normalization.
Query language parsing for natural-language metadata filters.

acceptance_criteria: POST /v1/search can return document chunk, artifact span and face observation hits with source_refs.
Unified search accepts metadataFilters and applies them to document/vector and artifact search paths.
Artifact search supports metadata-only search when query is omitted and a constrained filter is provided.
CLI exposes a unified search command using the HTTP API.
MCP exposes a unified_search tool using the HTTP API.
Integration coverage validates image OCR/caption, audio transcript, video keyframe, face and metadata-only unified search.

manual_checks: Confirm unified search remains HTTP/API based for CLI and MCP.
Confirm no RAW object mutation is introduced.

risks: Combined search must not bypass project authorization.
Metadata-only artifact search needs constraints to avoid unbounded broad scans.
Ranking across heterogeneous hit types must stay predictable for MVP.
definition_of_done: Task status is changed to done.
Branch is committed and merged back into master.
